server_specifications.starting_level: Level 80 (New players start directly at Lv 80)
server_specifications.starter_gear: Auto Equip gives +6 FB items up to Lv 79. Rook NPC in Donwhang provides starter beginner rewards.
server_specifications.union_limit: 2 Guilds per Union (Jangan Fortress has 2 Union limit, Bandit Fortress is No Union)
server_specifications.daily_gold_limit: 350M Gold (Increases to 500M Gold on weekends: Friday/Saturday/Sunday)

alchemy_system.max_plus: +10 without ADV (Maximum plus with ADV C is +12 or +13 glow)
alchemy_system.elixirs_upgrading: 100 normal elixirs + 2.5M Gold + 5 Arena Coins -> 50 SOS Elixirs (Elixir SOX Upgrader in NPC). SOS Elixirs can be upgraded into Moon Elixirs.
alchemy_system.lucky_scrolls: 2% Lucky Scrolls stack to 1k. 100x 2% Lucky Scrolls can be converted into 1x 3% Lucky Scroll (via Lucky Scroll Upgrader). Craftable 3% Lucky with Mining Elements.

adv_elixirs.adv_c_weapon_cracker: ADV C Weapon Cracker Scroll in NPC converts +10 SOX Weapon into ADV C SOX (+2 plus bonus, gives +13 glow). The original weapon is sacrificed/destroyed in the process.
adv_elixirs.adv_c_normal: ADV C Normal for all item types available via Magic POP and Normal ADV Box (cannot break +10 for ADV C normal).

alchemy_system.alchemy_boosters: Super Alchemy Reinforce Booster costs 150M gold and lasts 100 minutes. Fast Alchemy enabled in events.

seal_of_moon_guide.description: How Seal of Moon (SOM) crafting works in Exilium:
steps: 1. Drop untradeable 'Dead Moon Items' + corresponding Fragments inside Dungeons (HWT, Server Dungeon, Guild Dungeon).
2. Break unwanted Dead Moon Items with 'Moon Hammer' (bought from NPC) to gain extra fragments.
3. Buy 'Seal of Life' from NPC and use it on the Dead Moon Item to awaken it (reveals real fragment crafting requirement instead of 9999).
4. Craft the Dead Moon Item with required Fragments in the standard Alchemy Window.
5. Untradeable accessories can be destroyed with 'Dead Hammer' for fragments.
seal_of_moon_guide.moon_weapon_switchers: Nesta NPC offers Weapon Switchers for Moon Weapons (keeps the same plus and same stats/blues). Cost: 25 Event Coins, 250 Arena Coins, 500M Gold.

item_points_requirements.holy_water_temple: 4,000 Item Points (4-party dungeon, drops all elements)
item_points_requirements.party_dungeon: 3,850 Item Points (Boss has chance for ADV SoS Box/Lamp/10M Goldbar)
item_points_requirements.general_jobbing: 4,000 Item Points requirement was removed (open to all, except Aqua route)

job_system_details.triangle: Classic Hunter vs Thief vs Trader dynamic.
job_system_details.job_quests: Job Quests award 100% Job EXP, but player MUST be wearing their Job Suit when delivering the quests. Job temple mob quest requires 500 mobs.
job_system_details.job_suit_npc: Job Suit Breaker in Job Suit NPC destroys unwanted Job Suit and safely refunds Gold & Arena Coins back to player storage.
job_system_details.job_reverse: Special Thief Job Reverse cooldown is 90 seconds.
job_system_details.job_coins: Untradeable Job Coins awarded from daily job quests (15 kills daily quest).
job_system_details.job_remover: Job Remover available in Gift Silk Shop and for 75M Gold.
job_system_details.mercenaries: Guild Masters can purchase Mercenaries from NPC without job level restrictions.

fortress_war.jangan_fortress: Sunday 14:30 - 15:30 Server Time (2 Union limit). Winner receives Behemoth pet / Dark Lizard.
fortress_war.bandit_fortress: Sunday 16:30 - 17:30 Server Time (Balanced, No Union allowed).

major_events_and_schedules.weekly_ranking_reset: Resets every Sunday at 18:00 Server Time. Rewards: Top 1 Player (1,000 Silk), Top 1 Guild Master (1,000 Silk), Top 1 Jobber (1,000 Silk), Top 1 Battle Royale (1,000 Silk), Top 1 LoL (1,000 Silk).
major_events_and_schedules.chaos_job_event: Daily at 23:30 Server Time. Features Evil Terra, Evil Pyrex, Evil Kryon, Evil Dragon King (STR/INT), 8 Treasure Boxes spawn before Dragon. Each kill grants 1 Moon Elixir + 1 Event Coin.
major_events_and_schedules.evil_unique_takeover: Daily at 15:55 Server Time. All Evil Uniques spawn together across the map.
major_events_and_schedules.halloween_event: Evil Pumpkin Event every 6 hours (STR/INT in Job Temple treasure spawns). Drops Halloween Box (Halloween avatar/pick pet, random 1-500 Gift Silk, 1-25 Arena coins) + Evil Lamp + 15 Moon Elements.
major_events_and_schedules.earth_ghost_race: Replaces 4v4 survival in Togui Village (first to teleport wins).
major_events_and_schedules.anubis_and_isis: 21:45 Server Time daily. Drops 100% 1 SOS each, 1-25 Arena coins in chest, 3x Lamps, 10 Event Coins, 25% ADV C Normal.
major_events_and_schedules.selket_and_neith: Job Temple Uniques. Drops 3% Lucky Scroll 100%, 10 Event Coins, 25% ADV C Normal in chest.
major_events_and_schedules.evil_uniques_spawn: Evil Uniques (Evil Frostclaw STR, Evil Kong STR, Evil Elder, etc.) spawn every 4 hours.
major_events_and_schedules.roc_event: Roc INT and Death Bone STR spawn at Donwhang South. Resurrection cooldown inside Roc is 30 seconds. Drops ADV SOS Box.
major_events_and_schedules.medusa: Solo Medusa only (Balanced STR + INT). Drops 1 ADV SOS Box + Lamp for everyone in chest.
major_events_and_schedules.battle_arena: Random team matching. Requires 3,500 Item Points. Winner: 20 Arena coins, 20M gold, 2 Event Tokens, 200 Gift Silk. Loser: 10 Arena coins, 10M gold, 1 Event Token, 100 Gift Silk.

currencies_and_shops.silk: Official premium currency. Acquired via donation on website (https://exiliumonline.com/account/store) or winning weekly ranks.
currencies_and_shops.gift_silk: Earned by playing and participating. Gift Silk Converter converts 500 Gift Silk into 100 Tradeable Silk in VIP/Season room.
currencies_and_shops.event_coins: Earned by participating in events, killing Server Dungeon Uniques, Treasure boxes, Fortress War (15 coins for joining). Triple (3x) Event Coins on weekends (Fri/Sat/Sun). Can be sold for 10x Exilium Tokens in NPC.
currencies_and_shops.arena_coins: Obtained from Battle Arena, quests, fishing NPC (1-25 coins for 2 tokens), and dungeon chests.
currencies_and_shops.season_points: Earned from PvP kills in events, job temple, and using Card collections (50 Season Points per card used).

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Error C9 (Connection to server failed)
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Server under maintenance, port 15779 blocked, or firewall/antivirus issue.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. تأكد من قناة #announcements أو #server-status إذا كان هناك صيانة.
2. أضف مجلد Exilium كاملاً لقائمة الاستثناءات (Exclusions) في Windows Defender.
3. أعد تشغيل الراوتر لتجديد عنوان الـ IP.
4. افتح اللعبة دائماً من اللانشر كمسؤول (Run as Admin).
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Check #announcements or #server-status to see if maintenance is ongoing.
2. Add the Exilium folder to your Windows Defender/Antivirus exclusions.
3. Restart your internet router to refresh your IP.
4. Always run the Launcher as Administrator.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Error C8 (Client version mismatch)
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Outdated client requiring the latest patch.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: افتح اللانشر كمسؤول ليقوم بتحميل آخر تحديث (Update). إذا استمرت المشكلة، حمّل ملف Media.pk2 الجديد من قناة #downloads واستبدله في مجلد اللعبة.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Run your Launcher as Administrator to download the latest patch. If it fails, download the updated Media.pk2 from #downloads and replace it inside your game directory.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Game closes immediately / sro_client.exe disappears
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Antivirus quarantined sro_client.exe as false positive or missing runtimes.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. افتح Windows Security > Protection History واضغط Restore لملف sro_client.exe.
2. أضف مجلد اللعبة إلى Exclusions.
3. قم بتثبيت حزمة Visual C++ All-in-One وDirectX 9.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Open Windows Security > Protection History and Restore sro_client.exe.
2. Add the game folder to Exclusions.
3. Install Visual C++ All-in-One Runtimes and DirectX 9.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Character Stuck / Instant DC After Relog
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Character stuck in a bugged state, corrupted position, or crashed alchemy state causing instant disconnection upon login.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: لا يوجد زر فك تعليق على الموقع في إكسيليوم. يجب على اللاعب تزويد البوت باسم الشخصية (IGN)، ويتم عمل منشن فوراً لـ @Astro و @STAM لمراجعة قاعدة البيانات وإصلاح موضع الشخصية/العنصر في السيرفر، مع بقاء اللاعب غير متصل (Offline) حتى يتم التأكيد.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: There is no website unstick button. The player must provide their Character Name (IGN), and the ticket is escalated to @Astro and @STAM to check server database logs and teleport/fix the character while the player remains offline.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: BSObj Plugin: can't create file transfer manager! Maybe pack file corrupted or someone is already accessing it now
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: sro_client.exe or silkroad.exe is running in background holding lock on pk2 files, or launcher needs update.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. افتح Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc) وابحث عن sro_client.exe و silkroad.exe واضغط End Task.
2. افتح اللانشر كمسؤول (Run as Admin) لتحديث اللعبة.
3. حل أسهل: أعد تشغيل جهاز الكمبيوتر وافتح اللانشر كمسؤول.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
Method 1: Open Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc), find sro_client.exe and silkroad.exe in Processes and End Task, then reopen Launcher as Admin.
Easier Solution: Restart your computer, then open the Exilium Launcher (silkroad.exe) as Administrator to update your client.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Windows Defender blocking / deleting sro_client.exe or client closed immediately
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Windows Defender update falsely detecting game files as virus (false positive).
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. استثنِ مجلد Exilium كاملاً من Windows Defender: افتح Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions > Add exclusion > Folder واخر مجلد اللعبة.
2. إذا تم حذف الملف: افتح Protection History واضغط Actions > Restore لملف sro_client.exe.
3. إذا استمرت المشكلة حمّل ملفات الكلاينت النظيفة من موقع السيرفر exiliumonline.com أو روابط التحميل الرسمية المباشرة.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Exclude the Exilium folder from Windows Defender: Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions > Add folder > select your Exilium folder.
2. Open Protection History and click 'Restore' on sro_client.exe.
3. If files are corrupted, download clean files from official website exiliumonline.com or official direct mirrors.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Windows 11 Clientless / Frequent Disconnects / Random Game Crash
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Windows 11 windowed gaming optimizations and GPU switching interfering with game client.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. كليك يمين على سطح المكتب واضغط Display settings.
2. انزل واضغط Graphics.
3. اضغط Browse وحدد ملف sro_client.exe من مجلد Exilium.
4. اضغط على sro_client.exe بالقائمة واختر Options.
5. اختر High performance (كرت الشاشة الخارجي).
6. فعّل خيار Don't use optimizations for windowed games.
7. اضغط Save وأعد تشغيل اللعبة.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Right-click desktop -> select 'Display settings'.
2. Scroll down and click 'Graphics'.
3. Click 'Browse' -> find and select 'sro_client.exe' from your Exilium folder.
4. Find 'sro_client.exe' on the list and click 'Options'.
5. Select 'High performance' (dedicated GPU).
6. Check 'Don't use optimizations for windowed games'.
7. Click 'Save' and restart Exilium.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Auto Login Macro SRO_Client Crash or Immediate Close
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Windows Defender or Data Execution Prevention (DEP) blocking modified vSRO executables or third-party auto-login macro tools.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. أنشئ مجلد جديد على الكمبيوتر باسم SRO وأضفه إلى قائمة الاستثناءات (Exclusions) في Windows Defender.
2. ضع ملفات اللعبة بداخل هذا المجلد.
3. أضف ملفات Replacer.exe و Silkroad.exe و SRO_Client.exe إلى إعدادات الـ DEP (Data Execution Prevention).
4. شغل كل ملف (Macro Auto Login, Replacer, Silkroad, SRO_Client) مرة واحدة كمسؤول (Run as Administrator). إذا ظهر تحذير فايروسات الويندوز اضغط على More Info ثم Run anyway.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. Create a folder named SRO on your PC and add it to Windows Defender Exclusions.
2. Extract the game client inside this folder.
3. Add Replacer.exe, Silkroad.exe, and SRO_Client.exe to your Windows DEP settings.
4. Run Macro Auto Login, Replacer, Silkroad, and SRO_Client once each as Administrator. If a Windows warning appears, click 'More info' then 'Run anyway'.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Disconnection Upon Entering Game / Specific Region Crash (e.g. Samarkand / Frozen Dungeon)
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Corrupted map/teleport index files or missing client files during updates, often resolved by specific teleport routing or updating client paths.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. إذا واجهت فصل (DC) عند دخول اللعبة أو عند الانتقال لمنطقة معينة، استخدم المنفذ البديل (مثل الانتقال من Donwhang إلى آسيا الصغرى بدلاً من السفر المباشر).
2. تأكد من إيقاف تشغيل Windows Defender أثناء فك ضغط التحديثات.
3. قم بتطبيق ملفات الـ DLL المحسنة المقدمة من السيرفر لمنع الكראשات.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. If you disconnect when entering specific areas (like Samarkand), use alternative teleports (e.g., teleport from DW to Asia Minor).
2. Ensure Windows Defender is disabled when extracting game patches.
3. Apply the server's provided DLL updates designed to fix client crashes and disconnections.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Missing D3DX9 / Visual C++ Runtime Errors
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Missing core DirectX 9 or Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable packages required by the vSRO client graphics engine.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: قم بتحميل وتثبيت حزم الفويزيوال سي بلس بلس (Visual C++ Redistributable) وخطوط وملفات دايركت إكس 9 (DirectX 9) الناقصة في نظام التشغيل لديك ثم إعادة تشغيل الكمبيوتر.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: Download and install the missing Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable packages and DirectX 9 runtime components, then restart your PC.

common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: تحقق من سجلات الخادم (Server Logs) لمعرفة ما إذا تمت عملية الشخصية وخصم العملة (مثل 300m)، وإذا لم يتم تسليم العنصر، قم بإضافته يدويًا أو رد العملة للمتسبب في المشكلة التقنية.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: BSObj Plugin Error / Launcher Won't Open
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Player clicks launcher and nothing happens, or when opening ExiliumClient directly, they get a 'BSObj Plugin' error.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: 1. افتح مدير المهام (Ctrl + Shift + Esc)، وابحث عن أي عمليات تعمل لـ `sro_client.exe` أو `silkroad.exe` واضغط 'إنهاء المهمة'. 2. أعد تشغيل الكمبيوتر. 3. شغل دائماً من أيقونة **silkroad.exe** كمسؤول (ولا تستخدم ExiliumClient مطلقاً).
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: 1. Open Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc), find running instances of `sro_client.exe` or `silkroad.exe` under Processes and click 'End Task'. 2. Restart PC. 3. Always launch the game using **silkroad.exe** as Administrator (never ExiliumClient).

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Windows 11 Clientless / Instant Closure
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: Game closes instantly or goes clientless on Windows 11 upon startup.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar: 1. اذهب إلى إعدادات ويندوز > الشاشة > الرسومات (Graphics). 2. اضغط تصفح واختر ملف `sro_client.exe`. 3. اضغط خيارات > اختر 'أداء عالي' (High performance) وفعّل خيار عدم استخدام تحسينات ألعاب النوافذ. احفظ الإعدادات وشغل اللعبة كمسؤول.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en: 1. Go to Windows Settings > Display > Graphics. 2. Browse and select `sro_client.exe`. 3. Click Options > select 'High Performance' and check 'Don't use optimizations for windowed games'. Save and restart launcher as Admin.

common_errors_and_fixes.issue: Model Switcher Not Working / Failed to Switch
common_errors_and_fixes.cause: The weapon currently has an active Glow effect (like Bloody Glow) preventing the model switcher from applying, or requires manual server application.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_ar:
1. إذا كان السلاح عليه أي تأثير توهج (Glow مثل Bloody Glow)، يجب إزالة التوهج أولاً والمحاولة مجدداً.
2. إذا استمرت المشكلة: ضع السلاح والـ Switcher في الصفحة الأولى (Page 1) من الحقيبة، وقم بتسجيل الخروج تماماً (Log Off)، وسيتم عمل منشن لـ @STAM لتطبيقه لك يدوياً من السيرفر.
common_errors_and_fixes.solution_en:
1. If the weapon has an active Glow effect (such as Bloody Glow), remove the glow first and try again.
2. If it still doesn't work: place the weapon and switcher on the first page of your inventory, log off the game completely, and tag @STAM to apply it manually on the server.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: How do I claim my starting items and packages if they don't appear?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: كيف أستلم الحزمة البديلة أو أدوات البداية إذا لم تظهر في الشخصية؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: Starting packages, SP, and auto-equip gear are delivered automatically or through the character chest/inventory upon character creation or reaching specific milestones. If delayed, wait a short moment or check your inventory/storage chest.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: يتم تسليم حزم البداية ونقاط الـ SP وأدوات الـ Auto Equip تلقائياً في صندوق الشخصية (Chest) أو الحقيبة عند إنشاء الشخصية أو الوصول لمستويات محددة. إذا تأخرت، انتظر قليلاً أو تفقد صندوق التخزين.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: What is the maximum IP/PC character limit in the game?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: ما هو الحد الأقصى المسموح به لفتح الشخصيات بنفس الجهاز (IP/PC Limit)؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: The IP/PC character limit is set to 8 characters per hardware/connection.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: الحد الأقصى المسموح به لفتح الشخصيات بنفس الجهاز (IP/PC Limit) هو 8 شخصيات.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: Can I do both Trading and Thiefing without hitting a joint limit?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: هل يمكنني العمل كتاجر (Trader) وكرصاع/سرّاق (Thief) في نفس الوقت دون تأثر الحد الأقصى للذهب؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: Yes! Thiefing profit does not count towards the daily trader limit. You can max out your trader earnings and still make extra money through thiefing.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en_alt: Yes, thiefing does not belong to the trader limit. You can make your maximum profit from trading and then go thiefing to earn additional gold on top.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: نعم! أرباح السرقة (Thiefing) لا تتبع حد التاجر اليومي. يمكنك تحقيق الحد الأقصى المسموح به من التجارة ثم العمل كسرّاق لتحقيق أموال إضافية فوقها.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: How do Honor Buffs work if they don't appear in my buff list?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: كيف تعمل بوفات الشرف (Honor Buffs) إذا لم تظهر في قائمة البوفات الخاصة بي؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: If honor points and buffs have been refreshed, you need to un-equip and re-equip your job suit once to update and display your honor buffs correctly.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: إذا تم تحديث نقاط الشرف ولم تظهر البوفات لديك، كل ما عليك فعله هو إزالة بدلة العمل (Job Suit) وإعادة ارتداؤها مرة واحدة لتظهر البوفات بشكل صحيح.

learned_gameplay_faqs.question_en: How do I participate in Equalized/Balanced Events properly?
learned_gameplay_faqs.question_ar: كيف أشارك في الفعاليات المتوازنة (Balanced/Equalized Events) بشكل صحيح دون مشاكل في العتاد؟
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_en: For equalized and balanced events, place your secondary weapons or shields in the 1st and 2nd slots of your inventory to ensure proper scaling and functioning.
learned_gameplay_faqs.answer_ar: بالنسبة للفعاليات المتوازنة والمتساوية، يجب وضع الأسلحة الثانوية أو الدروع في الخانتين الأولى والثانية (1st and 2nd slots) من الحقيبة لضمان عمل النظام بشكل صحيح.

escalation_and_mention_rules.trigger_scenario: In-Game Disconnect (DC) or Item Purchase Glitch (Gift Silk / Item Mall / Immo)
escalation_and_mention_rules.action: Notify the player to provide transaction details, username, and IGN, and ping support roles if unresolved.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_ar: عندما يبلغ اللاعب عن فصل الاتصال (DC) أو مشكلة في شراء العناصر من متجر الهدايا (Gift Silk)، اطلب منه تفاصيل الحساب وقم بالإشارة إلى فريق الدعم.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_en: When a player reports a disconnect or an item purchase issue via gift silk, ask for their account details and tag the support team.

escalation_and_mention_rules.trigger_scenario: Game Balance, Stat Discrepancies, or Pet Speed Bug (e.g., Exile Dracarys Golden Dragon)
escalation_and_mention_rules.action: Acknowledge the report, inform the player that game data check is required, and escalate to management/developers.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_ar: عندما يتعلق الأمر بمشاكل إحصائيات اللعبة أو سرعة الحيوانات الأليفة التي تتطلب فحص بيانات اللعبة، قم بإخطار الإدارة وفريق التطوير.
escalation_and_mention_rules.guideline_en: When it concerns game stats or pet speed discrepancies requiring a game data check, notify management and developers.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Welcome to Exilium! Your request for the Starter Package has been submitted to the administration for confirmation. Mention @STAM and staff roles for quick approval.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: أهلاً بك في إكسيليوم! تم إرسال طلبك للحزمة الترحيبية إلى الإدارة للمراجعة والتاكيد. تم عمل منشن للإدارة للمتابعة.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Provide the web store link (exiliumonline.com/account/store). If the player paid and didn't receive silk, ask for their account ID/transaction ID and tag @STAM immediately.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: قم بتزويد اللاعب برابط المتجر (exiliumonline.com/account/store). إذا قام بالدفع ولم يتصل السيل، اطلب رقم الحساب أو تفاصيل التحويل وقم بعمل منشن لـ @STAM فوراً.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.scenario: In-game bug / character stuck / error C9
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Ask for the player's IGN, instruct them to stay logged off, and mention @Astro and @STAM to fix the character in the database.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: اطلب اسم الشخصية (IGN)، واطلب من اللاعب البقاء أوفلاين، وقم بعمل منشن لـ @Astro و @STAM لإصلاح الشخصية في السيرفر.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.scenario: Scam or player conflict / item loss / wrong NPC sale
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Acknowledge the item loss or wrong NPC sale. Ask for the character name and exact item details, then tag @STAM and Admin team for manual in-game inspection and restoration.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: أكد على مشكلة ضياع العنصر أو بيعه بالخطأ للتاجر. اطلب اسم الشخصية وتفاصيل العنصر بدقة، ثم قم بعمل منشن لـ @STAM وفريق الإدارة للمراجعة اليدوية والاسترجاع.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Inform the player that ban appeals must be reviewed by management. Tag @STAM and management roles directly to handle the appeal.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: أبلغ اللاعب أن طلبات إلغاء الحظر تتم مراجعتها حصرياً بواسطة الإدارة العليا. قم بعمل منشن لـ @STAM وفريق الإدارة للتعامل مع الطلب.

mention_and_escalation_matrix.scenario: General FAQ / Download / Alchemy rate / Client links
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_en: Provide direct download mirrors (Direct link, Mega, Google Drive, MediaFire) or explain server rates and game features directly without mentioning staff.
mention_and_escalation_matrix.bot_action_ar: قم بتزويد روابط التحميل المباشرة والمرايا (ميجا، جوجل درايف، ميديافاير) أو اشرح معدلات السيرفر وخصائص اللعبة مباشرة دون الحاجة لعمل منشن لأي مشرف.
